source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将翻，静压将破
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC37 after EP02 SC36 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where truth is on the edge of turning into open fact and the white-clothed woman's restraint is nearly broken into the next threshold: Keshadu's conclusion is almost impossible to pull back from, Shisilang's fury is one step from visible rupture, Tuobaye is nearly exhausted to emptiness, and the white-clothed woman's still pressure is about to turn into an unmistakable break.
title: 真相将翻，静压将破

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC36 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC36 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相欲翻，十四郎怒线将裂，拓拔野已近见底，白衣女子的静压已到欲破边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推进到真正翻面前的最后一瞬。科沙度的判断几乎就要成为公开事实，十四郎的怒势只差最后一下就会撕开局面，拓拔野几乎已经空到底，白衣女子的静压也来到只差一步就会真正破开的门槛。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从将翻和欲破推进到真正破面的门前，为明确出手、揭露或局面翻转准备直接引爆。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and controlled until the actual break source beat; do not spend the full overturn too early.
Keshadu should feel almost unable to keep truth from becoming shared fact.
Shisilang remains unstable and one step from visible rupture.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: truth on the verge of public turn, rupture-edge fury, almost-empty endurance, and breaking restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
